draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Harihareshwar! Locals call this town Dev-ghar, the house of God, and Dakshin Kashi, because its temple of Lord Harihareshwar is said to have been blessed by Lord Shiva.
draft.hungryLine: No named eateries in my notes, but this is Maharashtra, so look for kande bhaje, especially in the rains, or a plate of pohe with tea.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Harihareshwar Temple is towards the north of town, with the smaller Kalbhairav temple right beside it, and there's a beach on either side.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Pick one of the two beaches, north or south of the temple, and watch the Savitri river meet the Arabian Sea.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The town is ringed by three hills, Harihareshwar, Harshinachal and Pushpadri.

spots.name: Harihareshwar Temple
spots.detail: North of town · The temple said to be blessed by Lord Shiva

spots.name: Kalbhairav temple
spots.detail: In the temple complex · The smaller of the two adjacent temples

legends.title: The house of God
legends.body: The temple of Lord Harihareshwar is said to have been blessed by Lord Shiva. That's why the town is called Dev-ghar, and also Dakshin Kashi.

tips.title: Know what the MTDC resort is like.
tips.body: The MTDC resort on the south beach has a great location, but service and food at government-run resorts aren't the best.

tips.title: Make it a beach trio.
tips.body: Harihareshwar pairs with Shrivardhan and Diveagar for a weekend, about 190 km from Pune and 210 km from Mumbai.

story.title: Dakshin Kashi
story.body: The temple of Lord Harihareshwar, said to be blessed by Shiva, made the town a pilgrimage centre known as the house of God.

story.title: A festival for Kalbhairav
story.body: Yashawant Balawant Nagle, a Sardar of the Queen of Janjira who administered the village, began the Kalbhairav Jayanti Utsav and gave much of his property to run the temple.

story.title: Pilgrims and beach-goers
story.body: Harihareshwar is both a major pilgrimage centre and a beach resort, with Shrivardhan and Diveagar making it a weekend favourite from Pune and Mumbai.
